animation.title: Animation.load
animation.note: Provide the imported asset before Play and use a fresh target. Inspect Animation.clips for its actual clip names.

animation.title: Animation.addMarker
animation.note: Register Reveal first; add the marker before playback.

animation.title: Animation.blend
animation.note: This minimal example blends two instances of Reveal. Replace the names with two registered clips for a pose change.
